verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community note that the K3 API accepts vision input, though not via public image URLs. That implies image understanding exists, but nothing shows screenshot or photo upload in the Kimi assistant or tests how accurately it interprets images. missing for 10: first-party docs on image/screenshot upload in the assistant app, evidence of interpretation accuracy, hands-on corroboration of photo understanding, support for image URLs
